concepts.en_line: He started with the best intentions and ended up in a pile of paper balls.

shots.image: Photorealistic chunky ginger-orange classic tabby British Shorthair cat with a dense plush coat, bold darker orange swirl stripes on its sides, a white chin and white chest, round full cheeks and big round copper eyes, sitting upright and focused at a tidy small wooden study desk in a cozy bedroom at night. In front of the cat is an open notebook with blank cream pages, a yellow pencil and a neat stack of plain cloth-bound books in muted green and brown with blank covers, plus a warm glowing desk lamp and a white mug of tea with gentle steam. A dark window with soft city bokeh lights in the background. The whole cat is fully in frame and clearly visible, warm cozy lamplight, vertical composition
shots.motion: From the very first frame the ginger tabby British Shorthair taps the yellow pencil on the notebook with one front paw, then looks down at the blank pages with a serious focused face, blinks slowly and gives a small determined head nod. Steam rises gently from the tea mug and the city lights twinkle softly outside the window. The cat stays fully in frame with four normal legs. Photorealistic, smooth natural motion, static camera.

shots.edit: Keep exactly the same chunky ginger-orange classic tabby British Shorthair cat with the same fur pattern, face and eye color. Show the next beat: the same cat now lies on its side on top of the same wooden study desk, sprawled happily in a small pile of crumpled white paper balls, one front paw raised toward a paper ball, eyes wide and playful. The open notebook is pushed aside, the pencil lies on the desk and the plain books lean over in a messy stack, same desk lamp, same tea mug and same night window. Photorealistic, vertical composition.
shots.motion: From the very first frame the ginger tabby British Shorthair, lying on its side among the crumpled paper balls, bats one paper ball with a front paw so it rolls across the desk, then wiggles its head and taps another paper ball playfully, its tail swishing slowly. Steam keeps rising from the tea mug and the city lights twinkle outside. The cat stays fully in frame with four normal legs. Photorealistic, smooth natural motion, static camera.

trend.why_now: Korea's Suneung college entrance exam is on Thursday, November 19, 2026, four days from today, so exam week study memes fit right now. Meme sites are also posting cozy cats and cats sitting in boxes this week, and a ball of crumpled paper is that same 'cat picks the simple thing' joke.
trend.pattern: relatable 'expectation vs. reality' meme: shot 1 shows the serious, focused study start, and shot 2 is the punchline where the cat is happily playing in the mess. The caption sets up the before and after.
